{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk-blend sheath dress featuring a knee-length cut in a deep emerald green (#064e3b) with subtle satin finish.
Under the hemline, a sheer nude panel adds a touch of sophistication without compromising modesty.
The fabric drapes softly to create an elegant silhouette that flatters the figure while remaining comfortable for an evening out.

Loafers crafted from polished dark brown leather in a rounded toe design with minimal hardware detailing.
The sole is mid-height and cushioned to ensure stability and comfort throughout the date.
This shoe choice bridges the gap between dressy and wearable, perfect for walking in a restaurant setting.

Gold-plated stud earrings with a medium disk shape that catch the artificial lighting without being overwhelming.
A delicate chain necklace in yellow gold featuring a small geometric pendant rests gracefully against the collarbone.
This jewelry set adds just enough sparkle to elevate the outfit for a romantic dinner occasion.

A structured blazer made from a heavy wool blend in charcoal grey (#36454f) with notched lapels and two front buttons.
The jacket has long sleeves with French cuffs, providing warmth against the autumn chill while maintaining a refined look.
This outer layer balances the softness of the dress, adding structure appropriate for an evening date at 19:30.

This outfit works perfectly for a restaurant date in autumn because it blends elegance with practicality under artificial lighting. The emerald dress provides a romantic focal point that complements her skin tone, while the charcoal blazer adds necessary warmth for the season and the evening hour. The polished loafers ensure she can move comfortably through the venue without sacrificing style, and the gold jewelry ties the dark tones together with a warm, inviting glow suitable for a special occasion."}
